name: Ankit Verma
text: Pandit ji ke saath direct baat hui, koi middleman nahi. Griha Pravesh ke liye samagri list pehle hi WhatsApp par mil gayi — sab kuch time par ho gaya.

name: Priya Nair
text: We needed a Tamil-speaking pandit in Madurai for our wedding. Found three profiles with video intros, spoke to two on call, and booked the one we connected with. No commission, no pressure.

name: Rohit Deshmukh
text: Kaal Sarp dosh puja Trimbakeshwar mein karani thi. Platform par temple ke saath jude pandit ji mile — verification aur certificate dono dikhe. Bharosa ho gaya.

name: Sneha Agarwal
text: Durga Saptashati path ke liye Kamakhya ke pandit ji se seedha contact hua. Reviews padh ke decide kiya. Bas mobile app aa jaye toh aur asaan ho.

name: Karthik Menon
text: Living abroad, arranging my father's Shradh in Haridwar was my biggest worry. The pandit ji did a video call during the tarpan so we could all participate. Deeply grateful.

name: Manish Jain
text: Shop opening ka muhurat aur puja dono same pandit ji ne kiya. Kundali dekhi, phir date batayi. Direct call feature sabse best hai.
